title: Simple Present Tense — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: "My sister play the piano every day." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: My sister = she, jadi plays.

items.prompt: "They walks to the market." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: They tanpa -s: They walk.

items.prompt: "Does Rina likes milk?" Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Sesudah does, kata kerja tanpa -s: Does Rina like milk?

items.prompt: "He don't eat fish." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: He memakai doesn't: He doesn't eat fish.

items.prompt: Which sentence about Dad's job is correct?

visual.text: Dad do work in an office.

choices.say: Dad do work in an office.

items.reteach: Dad = he, jadi works.

items.prompt: "The baby cry at night." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: The baby = it/he/she, jadi cries.

items.prompt: Which sentence about my friends is correct?

visual.text: My friends is live in Surabaya.

choices.say: My friends is live in Surabaya.

items.reteach: My friends = they, jadi live tanpa -s.

items.prompt: "Do your cat sleep a lot?" Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Your cat = it, jadi Does your cat sleep a lot?

items.prompt: "I has two brothers." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: I have, bukan I has.

items.prompt: Which sentence about Mrs. Tari is correct?
items.reteach: Teach berakhiran -ch, jadi teaches.

items.prompt: "We goes swimming every Sunday." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: We go, bukan we goes.

items.prompt: "She doesn't eats vegetables." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Sesudah doesn't, kata kerja tanpa -s: doesn't eat.

items.prompt: What is Pak Darman's job?

stimulus.text: Pak Darman is a fisherman in Madura. He goes to the sea every night. He catches a lot of fish. He sells them at the market in the morning.

items.reteach: Kalimat pertama: Pak Darman is a fisherman. Fisherman = nelayan.

items.prompt: When does Pak Darman go to the sea?

stimulus.text: Pak Darman is a fisherman in Madura. He goes to the sea every night. He catches a lot of fish. He sells them at the market in the morning.

items.reteach: He goes to the sea every night.

items.prompt: In Pak Darman's text, "them" means …

stimulus.text: Pak Darman is a fisherman in Madura. He goes to the sea every night. He catches a lot of fish. He sells them at the market in the morning.

items.reteach: He sells them: yang dijual adalah ikan, the fish.

items.prompt: When does Oyen wake up?

stimulus.text: My cat, Oyen, sleeps all day. She wakes up at night. She plays with a ball and eats fish.

items.reteach: She wakes up at night.

items.prompt: What does Oyen eat?

stimulus.text: My cat, Oyen, sleeps all day. She wakes up at night. She plays with a ball and eats fish.

items.reteach: She plays with a ball and eats fish.

items.prompt: Which sentence about Oyen is true?

stimulus.text: My cat, Oyen, sleeps all day. She wakes up at night. She plays with a ball and eats fish.

items.reteach: Oyen tidur sepanjang hari (all day), bermain bola, dan makan ikan.

items.prompt: What does Dodi do on Wednesday?
items.reteach: Wednesday: draw. Dodi = he, jadi He draws.

items.prompt: When does Dodi visit his grandma?
items.reteach: Visit Grandma ada di baris Sunday.

items.prompt: On how many days in the table does Dodi do a sport?
items.reteach: Olahraga: swim (Monday) dan play football (Friday). Ada 2 hari.

items.prompt: What does Lani like?

stimulus.text: Lina and Lani are twins. Lina likes drawing, but Lani likes dancing. They both love ice cream.

items.reteach: Lina likes drawing, but Lani likes dancing.

items.prompt: What do the twins both love?

stimulus.text: Lina and Lani are twins. Lina likes drawing, but Lani likes dancing. They both love ice cream.

items.reteach: They both love ice cream. Both = keduanya.

items.prompt: In the twins text, "They" means …

stimulus.text: Lina and Lani are twins. Lina likes drawing, but Lani likes dancing. They both love ice cream.

items.reteach: They menunjuk Lina dan Lani.

items.prompt: Ana: "Does your sister like milk?" Bela: "Yes, she ___."
items.reteach: Pertanyaan Does …? dijawab Yes, she does.

items.prompt: Ben: "Do you play badminton?" Caca: "No, I ___."
items.reteach: Pertanyaan Do you …? dijawab No, I don't.

items.prompt: Teacher: "What does your mother do?" Dani: "She ___ a nurse."
items.reteach: She is a nurse = Ibu seorang perawat.

items.prompt: Tia: "Where does your uncle live?" Rudi: "He ___ in Malang."
items.reteach: He + -s: He lives in Malang.

items.prompt: Eko: "___ your dog bark at night?" Fani: "Yes, it does."
items.reteach: Your dog = it, jadi Does.

items.prompt: Gita: "What time do you go to bed?" Hadi: "I ___ to bed at nine."
items.reteach: I go, tanpa -es.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Does Pak Joko sell vegetables?" Iwan: "No, he doesn't. He ___ fruit."
items.reteach: He + -s: He sells fruit.

items.prompt: Kiki: "How do you go to school?" Lala: "My dad ___ me by motorbike."
items.reteach: My dad = he, jadi takes.

items.prompt: Mimi: "Do your parents work on Sunday?" Nino: "No, they ___."
items.reteach: Do …? dijawab No, they don't.

items.prompt: Oki: "What does Rina usually eat for breakfast?" Pia: "She usually ___ bread."
items.reteach: She usually eats bread.

items.prompt: Qori: "Does the bus stop here?" Driver: "Yes, it ___."
items.reteach: Does …? dijawab Yes, it does.

items.prompt: Rara: "What do cows eat?" Sasa: "They ___ grass."
items.reteach: They eat, tanpa -s.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "Budi plays football."
items.reteach: Budi = he: does not + kata kerja dasar (play).

items.prompt: Change into a question: "She likes cats."
items.reteach: Does + she + like (tanpa -s)?

items.prompt: Change "I" to "He": "I eat rice."
items.reteach: He + -s: He eats rice.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "They watch TV."
items.reteach: They: do not + kata kerja dasar.

items.prompt: Change into a question: "You speak English."
items.reteach: You memakai Do: Do you speak English?

items.prompt: Change "We" to "Rina": "We go to the library."
items.reteach: Rina = she, go menjadi goes.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: every / reads / Tia / a / book / night

visual.text: Tia reads a book every night.

choices.say: Tia reads a book every night.

visual.text: Reads Tia a book every night.

choices.say: Reads Tia a book every night.

visual.text: Tia a book reads every night.

choices.say: Tia a book reads every night.

visual.text: Every Tia reads a book night.

choices.say: Every Tia reads a book night.

items.reteach: Pola: Tia + reads + a book + every night.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "My cat eats vegetables."

visual.text: My cat does not eat vegetables.

choices.say: My cat does not eat vegetables.

visual.text: My cat is not eat vegetables.

choices.say: My cat is not eat vegetables.

items.prompt: Change "He" to "They": "He has a kite."
items.reteach: They have, bukan they has.

items.prompt: Change into a question: "The bird sings in the morning."

items.prompt: Arrange the words: Sunday / swim / on / We
items.reteach: Pola: We + swim + on Sunday.

items.prompt: Change "Ali" to "Ali and Bima": "Ali rides a bike to school."

visual.text: Ali and Bima ride bikes to school.

choices.say: Ali and Bima ride bikes to school.

visual.text: Ali and Bima rides bikes to school.

choices.say: Ali and Bima rides bikes to school.

visual.text: Ali and Bima riding bikes to school.

choices.say: Ali and Bima riding bikes to school.

visual.text: Ali and Bima is ride bikes to school.

choices.say: Ali and Bima is ride bikes to school.

items.reteach: Ali and Bima = they, jadi ride tanpa -s.

items.prompt: Which word fits both blanks? "Tom ___ milk. Lisa ___ juice."
items.reteach: Tom = he dan Lisa = she. Keduanya memakai likes.

items.prompt: Fill both blanks: "Ani ___ a cat, and her brothers ___ a dog."
items.reteach: Ani (she) has. Her brothers (they) have.

items.prompt: Odd one out: goes, watches, plays, run
items.reteach: Goes, watches, plays adalah bentuk he/she. Run tidak.

items.prompt: Odd one out: I, you, we, she
items.reteach: She memakai kata kerja -s (she plays). I, you, we tidak.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a helping word. I go with he, she, and it in questions. What am I?
items.reteach: Does he …? Does she …? Does it …?

items.prompt: Pattern: I play, he plays. I watch, he watches. I fly, he …
items.reteach: Fly menjadi flies.

items.prompt: Fill both blanks: "___ you like rice? ___ your sister like rice?"
items.reteach: You memakai Do. Your sister (she) memakai Does.

items.prompt: Which sentence tells about a habit?
items.reteach: Kebiasaan memakai simple present dan every morning.

items.prompt: "She go to school and eat lunch at home." How many words are kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Go menjadi goes, eat menjadi eats. Ada dua kata.

items.prompt: Fill both blanks: "My dog ___ not bark. My birds ___ not sing."
items.reteach: My dog (it) does not. My birds (they) do not.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am the he/she form of "carry". I end with -ies. What am I?
items.reteach: Carry menjadi carries.
